name: Pale Bloodfiend
tactics: A pale bloodfiend charges howling into battle, ignoring all threats as it lays into foes with double claw. Once bloodied, it seeks out a suitable target for heart of the vampire.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Double Claw
powers.requirements: The bloodfiend must not have a creature grabbed.

effect.description: The bloodfiend uses claw twice against the same target. If both attacks hit, the bloodfiend grabs the target.
The bloodfiend charges and makes the following attack in place of a melee basic attack.

hit.description: damage, and the target falls prone.

powers.name: Heart of the Vampire
powers.usageDetails: at the end of the bloodfiend’s turn if the power misses

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature grabbed by the bloodfiend

hit.description: damage, and the target is dazed and weakened (save ends both). The bloodfiend regains 20 hit points.

powers.name: Bloodfiend Ferocity
powers.trigger: The bloodfiend drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: The bloodfiend uses claw. If the attack hits, the target is dazed until the end of the target’s next turn.
